concept.title: Negative Space
concept.shortdesc: Negative Space is an important element of design.

conbody.p: Negative space is the space around or between objects, elements, or forms, that creates a form itself. The Pittsburgh Zoo logo is a gorilla and lion formed within the negative space of a tree.

image.alt: The Pittsburgh Zoo Logo has a gorilla and lion in the negative space

conbody.p: Negative space is commonly confused with white space, which provides breathing space for design elements in a composition.
